page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. This KVM-hypervised server features 64 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 64 vCPUs. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The CPU includes a 48 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and Vector AES. Local storage is not bundled, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with the instance scoring in the top 25% for multi-core stress-ng tests, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench multi-core evaluations. It also demonstrates strong capabilities in software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Cryptographic operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by a top-tier PassMark CPU encryption score. However, single-core performance remains average, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the middle 50% range. Memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations also perform at average levels.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated compute resources, the ecs.g7.16xlarge offers a highly resource-dense profile for multi-threaded enterprise workloads. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which is supported by the 32 Gbps network baseline. This server is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation pipelines, database operations, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
